title: Dheeraj
desc: A gang of dacoits terrorises innocent people by stealing their belongings and killing them afterwards. In response, DSP Dheeraj is ordered to bring them to justice.

title: Ee Jeeva Ninagagi
desc: Chandrashekhar and Rohini share a deep love and devotion for each other. However, their relationship faces challenges when Rohini discovers that Chandrashekhar is caring for his sister's child.

title: Snehitharu
desc: A group of four friends set out to rescue a young boy who has been kidnapped. However, soon their incompetence leads them in the wrong direction.

title: Liger
desc: A talented young MMA fighter trains hard to rise up the ranks. However, his goals are hindered when his lover is kidnapped.

title: Eradu Nakshatragalu
desc: A chance encounter between a poor boy and a prince, who are strikingly similar in appearance, prompts them to exchange lives.
